item.title: Match Report: Grimsby Town 2-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall walked away with a hard-earned point after a 2-2 draw at Blundell Park in Sky Bet League Two action tonight. item.title: Mat Sadler praises squad's work rate and determination in 2-2 draw at Grimsby
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler expressed his praise for the work rate and determination of his team at Grimsby Town on Wednesday night as his side picked up a point on the road in a 2-2 draw despite having 10 men on the pitch. item.title: Willis looks ahead to return to league action this weekend
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis is feeling optimistic ahead of the Saddlers’ West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One clash against AFC Telford United on Sunday afternoon.
